title: Ecommerce Website
description: A full-stack ecommerce platform built using the MERN stack. Includes user authentication, secure routes, dynamic product listing, and RESTful APIs for CRUD operations on product and user data.

title: To-do List Application
description: A responsive to-do app built with vanilla JavaScript. Features task creation, drag-and-drop reordering, filtering, and local storage for persistent task management.

title: Spotify Clone
description: A mini Spotify clone using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Users can play, pause, and skip tracks with a clean UI designed to mimic the core functionality of a music streaming app.

title: N-Queen Visualizer
description: A visualization tool built to demonstrate the N-Queen backtracking algorithm. Designed during competitive coding training to improve DSA understanding through visual learning.

title: gRPC Microservice Example
description: A simple gRPC-based microservice using Node.js. Demonstrates bidirectional streaming, unary RPC, and effective Protobuf usage for structured inter-service communication.

title: Weather Dashboard
description: React-based app to fetch real-time weather data using OpenWeatherMap API. Includes city search, error handling, weather icons, dark/light theme toggle, 5-day forecast, and recent search history.
